item.content: {"url": "https://api.crossref.org/works?query=How+does+persistent+identity+emerge+from+the+integration+of+memory+storage+and+subjective+information+creation%3F&rows=4&select=DOI%2Ctitle%2Cabstract%2CURL%2Cpublished", "scope": "Crossref bibliographic metadata and abstracts where supplied; not full papers", "excerpt": "[{\"DOI\": \"10.56975/ijrar.v12i3.317361\", \"title\": [\"Does Consciousness Emerge from Information Integration in Mind and Machines?\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.56975/ijrar.v12i3.317361\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2025]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.1007/978-981-96-6170-1_20\", \"title\": [\"How Does Information Emerge from a Black Hole?\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.1007/978-981-96-6170-1_20\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2025]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.2139/ssrn.6310458\", \"title\": [\"How Does Durable Coordinated Power Emerge?\"], \"abstract\": \"<jats:p>How does durable coordinated power emerge? The question is constitutive: not how power is distributed or legitimised, but what conditions make it structurally possible. From three minimal conditions-plurality, interdependence, and processing (interpretation, evaluation, anticipation)-this paper derives a structural chain showing that every path to coordination passes through meaning, and every path to durable coordinated power passes through a seven-dimensional coordination architecture. Four theorems specify its structural properties: it constitutes a functionally autonomous domain, it is critical infrastructure, it requires multimodal coherence, and structural advantage requires dimensional completeness. Six cases-Augustan Rome, Afghanistan, the 2024 United States presidential election, Germany, the European Union, and NATO-apply the derivation to historic and contemporary coordination structures, identifying conditions of stability and failure at a functional systemic level across all seven dimensions. Two independent derivation paths-bottom-up from the three starting conditions, top-down from five canonical premises-converge on these results. The derivation specifies conditions under which each element obtains and fails. It survives self-application without contradiction. The paper addresses the constitutive question of durable coordinated power from minimal premises shared across the social sciences and invites critical engagement from any disciplinary perspective.</jats:p>\", …
